input.final_summary: Feed is custom HTML cards (stored text/media), not X embeds. Tweet ID lookup exists only in rehydrate for media/avatar enrichment and intentionally keeps deleted posts. No delete/prune API yet; pagination is page/limit/hasMore/count. RWAScreener layout has no CSP or widgets.js.

content.text: ## Pipeline (store → API → UI) - **Persist:** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/meteora-intel/src/store.ts` — append-only JSONL `MentionRecord` (`id`, `text`, `url`, `author`, `media[]`, `metrics`, `isQuote`/`isReply`, `classification`, `scannedAt`). Seed on empty; `upsertMentions` replaces by id (rewrite file). **No delete/prune helper.** - **Ingest:** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/meteora-intel/src/ingest.ts` — classify → `saveMention` (skip known ids); trusted `upsertRecords` for rehydrate/reclassify. - **Filter:** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/meteora-intel/src/site-data.ts` — `filterFeed`: lane (`ecosystem`|`official`), `type` (`posts`|`replies`), window (`all`|`today`|`week`|`last_week`), optional `bucket`/`q`; newest-first. - **Serve:** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/meteora-intel/src/site-server.ts` — `GET /api/feed` → `toFeedCard` (stored fields only) + page slice. - **Proxy:** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/app/api/ecosystem-feed/route.ts` — forwards query to `$METEORA_INTEL_URL/api/feed`; 5‑min memory cache + `cache-control: max-age=120`. - **Render:** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/app/components/ecosystem-feed.tsx` + CSS in `/Users/semi/Vibecode/RWAScreener/app/globals.css` (`.eco-feed*` / `.eco-card*`). ## Cards: text vs embed - **Custom HTML cards only** — not X embeds / `blockquote.twitter-tweet` / `widgets.js`. - Card = `` with avatar, name/handle/time, **`post.text`**, up to 4 **stored** `media` ``s (pbs `?name=small`), engagement counts. - Whole card links out to X; no iframe/oEmbed. ## Tweet lookup by ID / deleted posts - **Search only in** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/meteora-intel/src/x-client.ts` — `/tweets/search/recent|all` (no ID lookup). - **ID lookup exists only in** `/Users/semi/Vibecode/meteco/meteora-intel/src/rehydrate.ts` — `GET …/tweets?ids=` batches of 100 for media/avatar/verified/`isReply` enrichment. - **Deleted/unavailable:** missing from `data` → `if (!enr) continue; // deleted/unavailable post — keep stored record`.
